sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling by junior members; no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong USD pressures multinational industrials, with earnings event in 28 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with RSI9 extreme overbought and new 10-day highs create short-term momentum setup, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (17/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD), zero fundamental support, earnings binary risk in 28 days, weak ADX trend strength, and price below 50/200 EMAs undermine conviction despite technical momentum.
